phrases.home.heroTitle: Self-Care For The Black Sheep & Bold Hearts
phrases.home.heroText: For anybody who's ever been told they're a little too much: taking up space and smelling amazing was always the plan.
phrases.home.badge1Text: Nothing mass-produced. If it's in stock, Savanna made it recently, by hand, on purpose.
phrases.home.badge2Text: Not a rainbow logo slapped on in June. This shop is queer at the root, year-round.
phrases.home.badge3Text: Calendula, arnica, magnesium, shea: stuff you can actually pronounce and trust.
phrases.home.badge4Text: Grown at farmers markets and Pride tables across the Upstate, one conversation at a time.
phrases.home.featuredText: The stuff y'all keep coming back for, from the flagship tee to the salve that actually gets your skin (and your sleep) to behave.
phrases.home.madeByHandTitle: Made By Hand, Made For Y'all
phrases.home.madeByHandText: Southern-raised, alt-inspired, and unapologetically queer, we make the stuff we wish existed for us.
phrases.home.communityText: Real folks, real photos, and handmade self-care. Tag @yallternativeliving on Instagram or TikTok to be featured!
phrases.home.popUpInTheWild: We Pop Up In The Wild
phrases.home.ugcText: From bedtime rituals to farmers market hauls — see how our handmade salves & soaks fit into your daily life.
phrases.home.faqIntro: Everything you need to know about our handmade salves, soaks, shipping, and custom orders.
phrases.footer.tagline: Handmade self-care for the black sheep & bold hearts. Mixed, poured, and stirred in small batches.
phrases.footer.disclaimer: Handmade self-care, not medicine. Nothing sold here is intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Got a real skin or health concern? See an actual doctor, then treat yourself to something that smells nice after.

phrases.footer.subscribed: You're on the list, y'all! Keep an eye on your inbox.

phrases.pdp.externalUseOnly: For external use only. Keep away from eyes and broken skin, and keep out of reach of children.
phrases.pdp.patchTestNote: New to it? Dab a little on your inner forearm and wait 24 hours before using it properly.
phrases.pdp.stopIfIrritation: Stop using it if irritation or a rash develops.
phrases.pdp.hadAReaction: Had a reaction? Tell us and we will log it and make it right.
phrases.pdp.notMedicine: Handmade self-care, not medicine: nothing here is meant to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition.
phrases.pdp.essentialOilsWarning: Contains essential oils. If you are pregnant, nursing, or using it on a child, check with your doctor first.
phrases.pdp.naturallyUnscented: Naturally unscented and free from added essential oils or synthetic fragrances. Perfect for sensitive skin.
phrases.pdp.nutAllergyNote: Made with plant butters and oils that can include tree-nut-derived ingredients (see the full ingredient list above). Skip it if you have a nut allergy.
phrases.pdp.noteBathTeaBag: Note: Comes with a reusable organic cotton muslin bag. Each bag is good for 2–3 soaks. Compost when spent.
phrases.pdp.noteCleansingSpray: Note: Shake gently before each use. Mist doorways, corners, or yourself: anywhere the energy feels stuck. Keep pets out of the room while you spray and off misted surfaces or fabric until it is fully dry. Not one for a house with cats.
phrases.pdp.noteFrankincenseAlmond: Note: Now made with almond oil (a tree nut). Not recommended if you have a nut allergy.
phrases.pdp.noteHandScrubIngredients: Note: Essential-oil free, but not a mild formula: the sudsing base brings sodium lauryl sulfate, denatured alcohol and methylisothiazolinone with it. If your skin is reactive, or you already know MI is one of yours, this is not the tin for you.
phrases.pdp.noteMiracleBalmNoEO: Note: No essential oils, no added fragrance.
phrases.pdp.noteKeychainBlend: Note: Exact salt/herb blend varies by the option you choose above.

phrases.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
phrases.faq.qCustom: Can I get something custom or in bulk?
phrases.faq.aCustom: Yep. Email us or send an Instagram DM with what you're picturing (gifts, market swag, wedding favors, whatever) and we'll figure it out together.
phrases.faq.qMeet: Where can I meet you in person?
phrases.faq.aMeetPrefix: Farmers markets and Pride events around Upstate SC and beyond. Check out our
phrases.faq.aMeetSuffix: or follow our socials so you know exactly where and when we'll be set up next.
phrases.faq.qUnscented: Do you have unscented or sensitive-skin options?
phrases.faq.aUnscented: We do. The Y'allternative Miracle Balm is unscented and essential-oil-free, made for skin that side-eyes fragrance.
phrases.faq.qShelfLife: What is the shelf life of your salves and soaks?
phrases.faq.aFreeShipping: Yes! Free shipping on any order of $40 or more. It applies automatically at checkout.
phrases.faq.shippingReturnsCustom: Shipping, returns, custom orders, unscented options.
